name: Anthemis multicaulis extract
description: Anthemis multicaulis extract (CAS 93333-76-7 ) is a botanical extract derived from a wild chamomile species native to Mediterranean and Middle Eastern regions. Used in flavoring and fragrance applications, it contributes characteristic floral and herbaceous notes to finished formulations. In flavor development, the extract is used to impart chamomile-type aromatic profiles to beverages, confectionery, and herbal food products where botanical authenticity is a priority. Fragrance houses incorporate it into personal care products such as lotions and shampoos. The extract delivers a soft floral character aligned with natural-origin positioning in skin creams and cosmetic applications. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulators may use it as a flavoring agent in oral preparations and herbal supplements. It is frequently utilized in functional products where chamomile-family botanicals are part of the intended sensory profile. Its botanical origin also supports natural and clean-label claims in product marketing across all three sectors. Anthemis multicaulis extract is typically supplied as a liquid extract or concentrated solution. The solvent type and extraction ratio vary by supplier and end-use requirement to meet specific formulation needs for global manufacturers. Technical and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most commonly available for this material. Documentation standards are strictly aligned to personal care and flavor industry requirements to ensure consistent quality and safety.
